summary: Inner colored pixels inside green frames emit outward through gaps in the green border, traveling diagonally until hitting grid boundary or another path, with collision rules determining trajectory changes.
src: non-green colored pixels inside green frames s
path: emit diagonally outward from gap in green frame, direction determined by gap position relative to s; continue until grid boundary or collision with another path
trajectory: paint s.color along entire diagonal path; when two paths collide at 90 degrees, both turn 45 degrees with one pixel gap at intersection and form diagonal line using single pixels; when paths meet at 45 degrees, paths merge without gap and both turn 22.5 degrees forming line using 2x2 pixel blocks
notes: Critical collision rule: for 90-degree collisions with 45-degree turns, there is a one-pixel gap at intersection and paths are drawn as single diagonal pixels; for 45-degree collisions with 22.5-degree turns, there is no gap and paths are drawn as 2x2 pixel blocks
